d.t: Any of the genus Ixia of cormous plants native to South Africa.
An indigenous Maya people in El Quiché Department, Guatemala.
Nothing; nix; often in the phrase "ixnay on ...", indicating something that must not be mentioned, often in Pig Latin
d.e: Ixnay on the "W-A-L-K" while the dogs can hear you.

d.t: To reject or cancel something; nix.
d.e: If I wasn't so bored out of my mind, I would have ixnayed that idea.

d.t: Any of the flowering plants in the genus Ixora.
d.e: He could see[…]some ragged red ixora hedges that need fixing up.
